why: At downsample 32 the painted zones hold few land cells (tree 57, hot dry 65, cold wet 54), so a recall loss of 0.03 is one or two cells. The best raw candidate (eval 213: zone objective 0.1881 against the control's 0.1835; cold wet 0.63 -> 0.78, hot dry 0.246 -> 0.277, Mediterranean dry share 5.2 -> 4.7 %, strict agreement +0.008) fails only the tree zone, 0.088 -> 0.035, i.e. 5 -> 2 of 57 cells. This amendment was motivated by that candidate; the deciding tests (native ds8 check, ~1,000 tree cells, and the nine-layout audit on layouts no campaign has run) are unchanged and unseen.
change: Coarse screen only: each painted zone's recall allowance becomes max(0.03, 2 x sqrt(r (1 - r) / n)), r the control's coarse recall and n the zone's land cells at downsample 32 (cold wet 0.131, warm wet 0.073, Mediterranean 0.061, tree 0.075, hot dry 0.107, cold dry and swamp 0.03). Strict agreement (-0.01), Mediterranean dry share (+0.01) and Cs share (-0.03) allowances, the raw zone objective above the control, numerical success and the guard-free ordering by raw zone objective stay. At most the two best such candidates advance to the plan's native check and, for the first that passes it, the plan's nine-layout audit, both exactly as frozen.
